name: The Sacred Flame
summary: Zangen Stonehoof sends you after a sacred flame and an ancient relic. To aid Rau Cliffrunner in Thousand Needles, you seek a moonwell phial in Ashenvale.

sections.title: Centaur Relics and Elven Waters
sections.body: The Galak centaur guard an ancient relic in Thousand Needles. The artifact dates to the beginning of their race, and sacred flames protect it. Zangen Stonehoof needs water blessed by the moon to quench those flames. He sends you north to Ashenvale, where the old forests hold the moonwell water he seeks.

sections.title: Trespassing in Ashenvale
sections.body: Pure moonwell water needs a vessel that will not taint it. You seek an etched phial carried by the Laughing Sisters, dryads near Raynewood Retreat. Submerge the phial in a moonwell along the western banks of the Falfarren River, then carry it back to Mulgore.

faq.q: Why does Zangen Stonehoof need moonwell water?
faq.answer: Zangen needs moonwell water for Rau Cliffrunner, his associate in Thousand Needles. Rau means to use its magic to quench the sacred flame guarded by the hostile Galak centaur, clearing the way for the Horde to recover an ancient relic.

faq.q: Where can the etched phial be found?
faq.answer: The Laughing Sisters carry the etched phial. These dryads wander the woods around Raynewood Retreat in central Ashenvale, just off the northern road leading west from Splintertree Post.

faq.q: Which moonwell should be used to fill the phial?
faq.answer: Use the moonwell near the western bank of the Falfarren River, south of the main road across central Ashenvale.

The Galak are an aggressive centaur clan in the dusty reaches of Thousand Needles. They guard an ancient relic from the founding of their kind, ringed by a sacred bonfire that Zangen and Rau mean to quench.

faq.q: Who receives the filled phial after Zangen?
aliases: where does the water go next
faq.answer: After Zangen inspects the filled phial in Thunder Bluff, he sends you south to Thousand Needles. There you deliver it to Rau Cliffrunner, who requested it.

faq.q: Why kill dryads for their phials?
faq.answer: Dryad vessels are made to hold pure, enchanted liquids without tainting them. Ordinary bottles cannot safely carry water imbued with the celestial power of a night elf moonwell.

angles.text: Centaur hostility has troubled the tauren for generations. A relic from the beginning of the centaur race may give Mulgore's tribes insight into their foes and an advantage against them.
As a tauren druid, you face a hard choice: slay nature's daughters, the dryads, to gather sanctified waters for a strike against the centaur's sacred flames.
Trouble around Raynewood Retreat risks worsening tensions with the night elves in Ashenvale. Centaur relics in Thousand Needles strengthen the Horde's southern frontiers.
